name: ASEAN

flag.description: A blue field with a red disc edged in white in the centre, holding a bundle of yellow rice stalks tied together.
flag.symbolism: The bound rice stalks stand for the countries of Southeast Asia joined in friendship; blue is peace and stability, red courage, white purity and yellow prosperity.

hook: ASEAN is a red disc on blue holding a sheaf of yellow rice stalks tied at the waist, a harvest bundle of Southeast Asian nations.
trivia: ASEAN was founded by the Bangkok Declaration of 8 August 1967, signed by Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand.
Timor-Leste became the 11th member on 26 October 2025, the first new member since Cambodia in 1999.
